questions.question: Cleanup: two small fixes. Quote the reviewer agent's description so strict YAML parsers accept it (a checked-in edit you review in git diff), and disable the unused context7 connection in this project (you run /mcp disable context7; /mcp enable undoes it). Token savings are about 0; the gain is robustness and one less connection. Apply both?

options.label: Clean up everything (recommended)
options.description: I quote the description in .claude/agents/reviewer.md, and you run /mcp disable context7. Both are reversible.

options.label: Let me pick
options.description: Choose which of the two to apply in a follow-up question.

questions.question: Permissions, separate from cleanup: make auto mode your default by adding "permissions": {"defaultMode": "auto"} to ~/.claude/settings.json (your dotfiles symlink, so every project). A safety classifier then approves routine actions instead of prompting you. No allow rules are proposed. Apply it?

options.label: Apply it (recommended)
options.description: Writes defaultMode auto to the user settings file. Remove the key to undo.

options.label: No, keep prompting me
options.description: Leave the default permission mode unset.
